title: angelica keiskei
intro: Angelica keiskei, commonly known as Keiskei Angelica or Ashitaba, is a perennial plant native to East Asia, belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the ability to improve eye health, boost the immune system, and support digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Angelica keiskei include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include chalcones, flavonoids, and other polyphenolic compounds, which have been shown to possess antimicrobial and anti-oxidant activities.
